description.value: A small islet on the BC Marine Trails network near North Vancouver, reachable only by kayak or boat; free and primitive with no confirmed amenities, making it a non-starter for loaded cycle tourists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific BC Marine Trails page for Little Flower Islet returned a 404 'Page not found' error — the site has migrated content to a member map — so all amenity details must come from OSM tags alone. OSM confirms a backcountry tent-only campsite (backcountry=yes, tents=yes, capacity:tents=3, caravans=no) on what is clearly a marine islet near Howe Sound, accessible only by water per the Sea to Sky Marine Trail context. No phone, address, or detailed amenity data is available from either source.
concerns: Website page returned 404 — BC Marine Trails has migrated site-specific pages to a member-only interactive map; no detailed amenity data could be verified.
This campsite is located on a marine islet and is accessible only by water (kayak/paddling); it is not reachable by bicycle, which may limit its relevance to the cycling tourism directory.
No address, phone, or contact details available for this backcountry site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible backcountry campsite confirmed by OSM; no evidence of closure or non-existence. Water-access-only nature is worth flagging but is not grounds for exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags: backcountry=yes, tents=yes, capacity:tents=3, caravans=no, static_caravans=no, access=yes. Coordinates place this in Howe Sound on the Sea to Sky Marine Trail.
